findings.title: Engineering review removes frozen first-prompt dollar sublimits
findings.observed: First $55 and first-assessment $25 checks are conditional on no engineering_review. The first barrier can record a review with first_assessments_closed=false and run_all resumes first assessments after review, bypassing the retained first-prompt caps.
findings.minimal_fix: Always enforce $55 and $25 on p3b-01 admissions regardless of review. An irrecoverable mandatory first-assessment cap stop must close the attempt. Add post-review limit boundary tests.
findings.status: Open at review; reported to root.
